execution_authorization_mechanism: live run requires <run_dir>/APPROVED.json containing this manifest's sha256 (+model, max_requests=8); this manifest is never edited to authorize
excluded: gemini-3.5-flash (kept in frozen plan; temporarily unavailable; not a fallback)

pacing: min 13 s between any two requests incl. retries; monotonic in-process, wall-clock across restarts (resume never resets it)

retry_policy.rate_limit_429: max 2 retries per app, back-off 30 s then 60 s (pacing still enforced); each retry consumes the global budget
retry_policy.server_5xx: no retry on same app; app left un-checkpointed

stop_policy: two consecutive 5xx on different apps -> stop
no modelVersion in response -> checkpoint written, model_identity_verified=false, stop for review
schema violation -> stop, raw output kept in stops/rejected_<id>.json, not repaired
app 1 evidence quote/url failure -> checkpoint written, stop for review
client error (400/401/403/404), network error, malformed response -> stop
corrupted/partial checkpoint, state or log -> refuse to start
any stop needing review blocks restart until STOP_REVIEWED.json (matching stop sha256) exists
